statement: A metric with no bound data source must not render a numeral. State the absence, name the object that is missing, and offer the binding action.
mechanismHypothesis: A numeral in metric typography is read as a measurement regardless of adjacent copy, because the reader's eye reaches the figure before the caption. $0 is uniquely dangerous among numerals: it is a plausible true value for a new or quiet business, so the reader has no internal contradiction to prompt a second look. Refusing to render removes the misreading rather than annotating it.
confidenceBasis: Three shipped products, two of which refuse cleanly and one of which does both on a single screen. The disagreement is what makes this citable rather than a house style — but no audience-task evidence (M3) was collected, so the mechanism is hypothesised from the artefacts, not measured on users.
appliesWhen: the surface presents a figure a user would act on
the data source is unbound, unconnected, or synthetic
zero is a plausible real value for this metric
doesNotApplyWhen: the metric is a genuine measured zero from a bound source — that must render, and suppressing it would be its own lie
the surface is a management or settings list with no metric to withhold (see obs-wise-empty's own boundary)
the figure is explicitly framed as an example inside disclosed demo mode
counterexampleNote: obs-midday-empty is retained deliberately as the anti-reference. A shipped, audience-proven product does the wrong thing three tiles below doing the right thing, which is stronger evidence that the failure is easy than any invented fixture would be.

boundToGate.relationship: This rule is the visual form of the schema constraint already shipped: a claim with rendersData true requires a contentBinding, and an unbound claim cannot be rendered as bound. The schema makes the dishonest record unrepresentable; this rule says what the honest surface looks like.

reVerifyReason: Sources stay remote and uncached by licence, so the records can drift from the live products without any local signal. Re-inspection is the only way this collection stays true.
tierLadder: M3 audience-task evidence > M2 live shipped-product observation > M1 official demonstration or documentation > M0 recipe or showcase. This rule may not be promoted to audience-proven on M2 alone.
